name: ICW: The Last Call
notes: A card and no results. The fed announced twenty superstars for it on 2 October 2005 under a note reading “Card subject to change”, and the show forum's own topic list carries the card it was booked into: a thirty-man battle royal, one tag match (Drowners of Fate against “Stone Cold” Steve Austin and The Elite) and five singles matches (“Eye Candy” Randy Walker against Darkside, Hawk against Shane Helms, Nightcrawler against Neta, The Undertaker against Jonathon Monroe, Tatewaki Kuno against Carnage), plus a deadline thread and a sign-up thread. Not one of those match threads was ever archived and no results document was ever captured, so no match on this card carries a declared outcome and none is structured. Every appearance here is a billing and nothing more. The forum's last dated action is 5 December 2005.
